use "net"
actor Main
  new create(env: Env) =>
    let auth = env.root
      let notify = object iso is TCPConnectionNotify
        fun ref connected(conn: TCPConnection ref) => None
        fun ref connect_failed(conn: TCPConnection ref) => None
        fun ref received(conn: TCPConnection ref, data: Array[U8] iso, times: USize): Bool => false
      end
      TCPConnection(auth, consume notify, "93.184.216.34", "80")
